texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]上获取了一些奇怪的读数，很有可能表明其上有生命存在。由于这些信号较为微弱，而且在我们试图与之联系时毫无反应，所以如果想弄清真相，我们需要派出一支研究团队。
texts.en: We have picked up some curious readings from [From.GetName], possibly indicating the presence of life. Given the weakness of these signals and the lack of response as we attempt to contact these lifeforms, we must send a research team if we are to figure out what might have happened.

texts.zh: 我们捕捉到了一些来自[From.GetName]的读数，这可能意味着生命的存在。我们应该派遣一些[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]，搞清楚是什么在发射信号。
texts.en: We have picked up some readings from [From.GetName], possibly indicating the presence of life. We should send some [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] to look into whatever might be transmitting a signal.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]上获得了一个不寻常的信号，似乎是在尝试与我们联系。然而我们还不能与这个信号源进行沟通，如果想对其了解更多，我们需要派遣一艘舰船进行仔细检查。
texts.en: We have picked up on uncommon signals coming from [From.GetName], seemingly trying to initiate contact with us. We have been unable to communicate with whatever or whoever it is, and will have to send a ship to inspect it more closely if we want to learn more about what it might be.
